name: Photo Frame
author: dxvmxn
description: Wallpaper-level picture frame that slowly cycles through the images in a folder with a paper matte and crossfade. Add several frames, each with its own folder. Drag/scale in edit mode like any desktop widget.

settings.label: Images folder
settings.help: Folder scanned for images (jpg, png, webp, gif). ~ is expanded.

settings.label: Change interval
settings.help: Seconds each photo stays up before the next one.

settings.label: Shuffle order
settings.help: Pick the next photo at random instead of in order.
